name: Swiss School Singapore
summary: Swiss curriculum education with multilingual pathways for Swiss and European families.
body: Swiss School Singapore supports Swiss educational continuity with multilingual exposure. It is a niche but critical option for Swiss postings and families seeking Swiss pedagogy. Capacity is limited relative to mega-campuses — contact admissions as soon as relocation is firm. Smaller communities can intensify parent belonging at the gate — still separate pastoral welcome from fever-day coverage contracts at home.
